definitions.explanation: The three-stroke radical ({氵|さんずい}) derived from {水|みず}, used in kanji related to water or liquids.

examples.japanese: さんずい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Kanji with the sanzui radical are related to water.

examples.japanese: さんずい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To look it up by the sanzui radical.

notes:
さんずい is one of the most common kanji radicals. The name comes from ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧ (three) + {水|すい} (water), describing its three-stroke shape derived from ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧.

KANJI WITH さんずい:
- ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧ (sea), ⟦{池|いけ}→池：00848_ike⟧ (pond), ⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧ (lake)
- ⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧ (to swim), ⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧ (to wash)
- ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧ (wave), ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧ (sweat), ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧ (tears)
- ⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧ (warm), ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧ (deep)

USAGE:
Knowing radicals helps with kanji dictionary lookup and guessing meanings. Almost all kanji with さんずい relate to water, liquids, or fluidity.

RELATED RADICAL TERMS:
- ⟦{部首|ぶしゅ}→部首：00023_bushu⟧: radical (general term)
- ⟦にんべん→にんべん：23624_ninben⟧: person radical
- ⟦きへん→きへん：23625_kihen⟧: tree radical
- ⟦てへん→てへん：27336_tehen⟧: hand radical
- ごんべん: speech radical
